title: Onboarding UI: activate license / provision tenant
body:
## Original (as captured)
Operator + portal flows to add/enable a tenant, send invites, and land the owner in their dashboard.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0065)
Idempotent tenant provisioning (tenant + owner user + defaults), license activation, and the operator-manual add-tenant path; emit audit events.
